Subject: Elara deal: request to accelerate tenant-routing + SLA telemetry

Team —

Quick background: Elara is at final procurement (legal + SOC proofing) but their buying decision is now gating on two items we can reasonably ship as targeted work:

- Customer-level routing (per-tenant model affinity / soft pinning) so requests from Elara always hit the quantized Llama variant we've validated for them.
- SLA telemetry hook: per-tenant latency percentiles and token-cost reporting surfaced to their console and ours (they need this for internal chargebacks).

Why this matters: deal ACV ~ $1.1M ARR; close window is ~2 weeks (procurement has an internal commit deadline). If we can promise a staged delivery (canary + fallback to shared model), they sign and push payment terms early.

Ask: can Product/Eng consider a focused prioritization to deliver an MVP (routing flag + telemetry event stream) as a scoped sprint chunk or a 2-week hotfix — ideally with a short canary + toggle? Attached is the updated mutual action plan Elara asked us to sign (Elara_MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf) and a suggested SLA matrix (elara_sla_matrix.xlsx).

Options I can accept as a sign-off:
- Full small-scope sprint (estimated 3 sprints) + committed rollout timetable (preferred), or
- One-sprint emergency cut (reduced scope: flag + basic telemetry) with a clear follow-up plan.

I routed this to Priyom because he knows the runtime constraints and to Jasmine for deployment/ops feasibility. Marissa is copied for commercial context.

Next steps: If we can get a feasibility + rough scoping today, I can update Elara and lock the procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Aditya

Thanks for the context. Quick technical read:

Summary: Feasible with a scoped effort. Proposed approach and trade-offs below.

MVP scope (target 2 sprints):
- Routing: a lightweight tenant routing flag + policy (config-driven) that maps tenant ID -> model variant alias. Implement as a runtime switch and a matching config file; include unit tests and validation tooling. (Low risk to runtime; relies on existing model aliasing.)
- Telemetry: emit per-request envelope with tenant_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_alias. Stream to existing metrics pipeline (we can add a tenant aggregation layer on the metrics side).
- Safety/fallback: feature toggle at route level; default behavior falls back to shared model instance if the routing config fails.

Estimate: 2 sprints (4 engineers, 0.5 SRE) to build + QA + canary. If Product requires a 1-sprint emergency delivery we can compress scope to only the routing flag + minimal telemetry (no aggregation dashboards) but it will be technical debt that needs follow-up.

Blockers/concerns:
- We need Prod approval for adding tenant_id to telemetry (privacy/data classification) — may affect SOC 2 mapping.
- Metric cardinality: Elara expects percentile breakdowns per tenant; if we have many tenants this increases cardinality and cost. We should agree on retention window and cardinality limits with Finance.
- Release window: Ops needs a 24–72 hour blackout around platform deploys; if Elara expects a hard date we need to coordinate schedule.

If Product is comfortable with the 2-sprint plan I can draft an Epic and break down work items. Draft Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4821 (placeholder).

Priyom

--
Priyom Das

Thanks Priyom — that sounds reasonable and covers the ask.

Decision: We approve the 2-sprint scoped plan (MVP) with the following conditions:
- Product will own the prioritization window and accept the follow-up tech debt backlog itemization.
- Security/SecurityOps to sign off on tenant_id telemetry scope within 48 hours; if there are unresolved SOC 2 concerns, we will fall back to anonymized tenant hashing with a 30-day retention cap.
- Ops to provide a deploy window; Priyom/Jasmine please coordinate and confirm the canary schedule by EOD tomorrow.

Aditya: I will tell Elara we can commit to a staged delivery (canary first, full rollout after 2 sprints) and that we will include the telemetry hooks as described. Please hold off on contract signature until Security confirms telemetry scope (48h).

I'll open the Jira Epic and link the deliverables to the deal. Priyom — please convert ENG-4821 into a proper epic and add sub-tasks; Jasmine, please add any SRE runbook notes to the epic.

Thanks —
Marissa
